items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: It was his band. It was Elvin Coward. It was Benny Pinnum.

ctx.x: What about the St. Peter's band with Arnold De Pass? Yeah. I never did hear anything about that band. Could you tell me something about that band? Well in that band. The first band was Arnold. I know of the hit of the band.

It was his band. It was Elvin Coward. It was Benny Pinnum. It was bamboo I tried more. And, uh, six pieces, seven pieces, whenever they had a piano. Black in San Diego was a piano player. And when that piano was organized, I didn't know who played with it. I know people who played with them for a while. And I wouldn't have played with them for a while. How long do you want to be playing with them for a while? I don't know about it for a few years. Mostly they were with the white guys. Bones of training over…
Would you say you were in demand? Would you say you were in demand? Well, I was, I was a young man.
